title: The SAbyNA platform: a guidance tool to support industry in the implementation of safe- and sustainable-by-design concepts for nanomaterials, processes and nano-enabled products
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,4008-4025
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00312A, Paper

Virginia Cazzagon, Ralph Vanhauten, James Hanlon, Araceli Sánchez Jiménez, Sam Harrison, Melanie Auffan, Hedwig Braakhuis, Matthew Boyles, Ana Candalija, Alberto Katsumiti, Isabel Rodriguez-Llopis, Julia Catalan, Richard K. Cross, Elma Lahive, Elise Morel, Felice C. Simeone, Camilla Delpivo, Simon Clavaguera, Richard Seddon, Apostolos Salmatonidis, Leire Barruetabeña, Lion Traas, Davide Lotti, Claire Mays, Socorro Vázquez-Campos
The SAbyNA platform supports value chain actors in developing safe-by-design nano-enabled products early in their development phases. The potential of digital guidance is exemplified in a case study on carbon nanotube-based 3D-printed products.
